description: Every prop type any map can place. A type gives defaults; a placement in a map file gives its top-left x, y and only the fields that differ (null removes a default). Fields are the authored appearance options the prop artists read (decorType, color, interactionType, ...). movable: the player can grab and push it. A type that names a family is a preset of it: a family is a kind of piece one artist draws, and its look is a schema of the fields a type or a placement may set (look: {...}, field by field).

bentwood_chair.description: A bentwood cafe chair seen from above: a round seat in a wooden ring, a curved back. Turns to its face.

seats.note: one seat colour is chosen per chair

upholstered_seat.description: A tufted armchair or sofa: a back, two deep arms, one cushion per seat, sometimes a knitted throw. Turns to its face.

upholstery_dark.note: the shadow colour for each upholstery colour, in the same order

cushioned.note: a scatter cushion in the first seat

throw.note: how often a knitted throw lies over it

booth_bench.description: A padded booth bench with its back to the wall. Turns to its face.

cushion_bench.description: A window bench: cushions in turn along it, pillows against the glass. Turns to its face.

bookcase.description: A case of well-read spines, a few leaning.

record_player.description: A sideboard with a turntable turning and a stack of sleeves.

chalkboard_easel.description: A chalkboard on legs with two lines of chalk.

range_stove.description: A kitchen range: four burners, a pot of soup on one, a copper pan on another, knobs along the front.

double_sink.description: A steel double sink with a tap between the bowls.

prep_table.description: A butcher-block table: a scored loaf, a board and knife, a bowl of lemons.

fridge.description: A fridge seen from above: two doors, handles, notes and a drawing stuck on.

lamp_table.description: A small table with a pleated table lamp on it; a nightstand has a drawer pull.

oval_coffee_table.description: An oval coffee table: two books and a vase of flowers.

slipper_chair.description: A rounded slipper chair, the back to the south.
